responsibility: This C utility generates GNU Modula-2 startup code or a linker command line from a module list description read from standard input or a named file. It parses command-line options controlling startup-versus-link output, main symbol naming, explicit libraries, profiling modes, language mode (C or C++), extra GCC -f arguments, and whether an exit wrapper is needed, then tokenizes the module list with its own buffered scanner and emits the corresponding startup/link artifacts. The file therefore owns the low-level text parsing and output construction used by the gm2 build/link stage to assemble module initialization order and final linkage information.
